newlinesBetweenDefinitions.markdownDescription: Blank lines inserted between adjacent definitions.

newlinesBetweenSetDefinitions.markdownDescription: Blank lines inserted between adjacent `Set`-family definitions. When omitted, inherits `newlinesBetweenDefinitions`.

newlinesBetweenSetDelayedDefinitions.markdownDescription: Blank lines inserted between adjacent `SetDelayed`-family definitions. When omitted, inherits `newlinesBetweenDefinitions`.

newlinesBetweenSetAndSetDelayedDefinitio.markdownDescription: Blank lines inserted between mixed `Set`-family and `SetDelayed`-family definitions. When omitted, inherits `newlinesBetweenDefinitions`.

newlinesBetweenSameNameDefinitions.markdownDescription: Blank lines inserted between adjacent definitions that belong to the same symbol.

maxBlankLinesBetweenCode.markdownDescription: Maximum source blank lines preserved between non-definition code statements.

trailingNewline.markdownDescription: Emit one trailing newline at the end of non-empty formatted files.

spaceAfterComma.markdownDescription: Insert space after commas in argument lists.

alignRuleValues.markdownDescription: Align `Rule` and `RuleDelayed` values vertically in multiline argument, list, and association layouts.

documentationCommentColumn.markdownDescription: Column for trailing documentation comments. `0` = auto-compute per contiguous block.

documentationCommentPadding.markdownDescription: Minimum spaces between code and an aligned trailing documentation comment in auto mode.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Apply definition spacing only to adjacent declarations; preserve ordinary code spacing up to `maxBlankLinesBetweenCode`.
Apply top-level spacing to all statements.

preserveTildeInfixFunctions.markdownDescription: Comma-separated function names that stay in `~f~` infix form instead of normalizing to `f[x, y]`.

moduleVarsBreakThreshold.markdownDescription: Character count at which `Module`/`With`/`Block` var list breaks.

conditionFirstFunctions.markdownDescription: Comma-separated symbols whose first arg stays on same line as head.

caseStructureFunctions.markdownDescription: Comma-separated symbols using alternating condition/body indentation.

lintRules.markdownDescription: JSON object string of per-rule level overrides, for example `{"prefer-rule-delayed":"error"}`.
